metadata.description: Spickzettel: persistent, curated memory for Claude Code, split into independently installable plugins.

plugins.name: spickzettel-files
plugins.description: Curated MEMORY.md + USER.md with char limits, injected as a frozen snapshot at session start and after compaction.

plugins.name: spickzettel-tool
plugins.description: `memory` tool (add/replace/remove/batch) as a local MCP server. Pulls in spickzettel-files.

plugins.name: spickzettel-search
plugins.description: `session_search`: SQLite FTS5 full-text search over all past Claude Code sessions (search/scroll/read/browse).

plugins.name: spickzettel-skills
plugins.description: Skills as procedural memory: self-created skills, /learn, usage tracking, 14-day stale / 30-day archive curator.

plugins.name: spickzettel-all
plugins.description: Bundle: installs all four Spickzettel plugins.
